name: Align 360
tagline: Task manager, analytics and team messenger for construction and renovation crews
role: React Native app development for a US client

scenes.title: Contractors and subs, one app
scenes.body: Contractors organize each job; subcontractors of every trade sign in and work on the same projects.

scenes.title: A daily brief on the home screen
scenes.body: Projects, new and outstanding to-dos, materials and team messages in one workspace view.

scenes.title: Each job split by room and trade
scenes.body: Rooms and trade to-do lists hold dated tasks; progress counts show what is left and what is done.

scenes.title: Plans that scale with the crew
scenes.body: Free for one user; monthly in-app subscriptions for teams of 2–5, 6–9, 10–14 or 15+ members.
